headline: Paramount-WBD merger becomes Skydance as CNN's chief executive remains
summary: Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery's roughly $110 billion merger will be named Skydance, the companies announced. CNN CEO Mark Thompson will remain head of the news network once the acquisition closes.
